video.title: AI欧腐《被未婚夫的教父标记了/Marked by My Fiancé’s Mafia Godfather》
video.desc:
能吃
Drugged by his cousin, Samuel stumbles into Vincent's suite and shares a 100% fated one-night mark. To reclaim his parents' legacy, he hides the bite and still plans to marry Antonio. At the engagement, his cousin exposes the mark; Antonio rages and shames him. Just in time, Vincent arrives.
被堂弟下药的 Samuel 误闯进 Vincent 的套房，与他共度一夜，留下了一枚百分之百契合的命定标记。为了拿回父母的遗产，他藏起咬痕，仍打算和 Antonio 结婚。订婚宴上，堂弟当众揭穿了标记，Antonio 勃然大怒、百般羞辱——就在这时，Vincent 到了。
